entities.title: "Games" under the game goes to the About page
entities.summary: The site links under the game link Games to /, which on icelander.net is the About page, not the list of games.
entities.expected: Games opens the games list at /games/.
entities.observed: It links to / (icelander.net/), the same address as the About and contact link beside it: a leftover from when the games lived at the root of games.icelander.net, before commit edfb3fe moved them to icelander.net/games/retro/.
reproduction: Choose Games in the links under the game
acceptanceCriteria: The Games link under the game leads to /games/.

origin.description: Found while documenting Shatterbelt: the nav.site-links element.
